title: AdvisoryAssessment (finding classification, exact-binding)
$comment: Structural residue of the release.* rules (P0-7). One assessment per (advisory, component, subject): the classification plus the exact bindings that scope it (release.advisory.reachability-binding). component_absent is the only classification that exits the waiver path, and only via the final artifact's SBOM (release.advisory.component-absent); everything else stays a finding — evidence, never erasure (release.decision.evidence-separated). $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref).

componentRef.$comment: Package URL (purl) or equivalent exact component reference, matching the SBOM entry it is judged against.

sourceDigest.$comment: Digest of the exact source snapshot the reachability analysis read, when the analysis is source-based.

classification.$comment: Reachable HIGH/CRITICAL blocks release non-waivably (release.gate.high-critical-zero); unreachable still needs a dated waiver (release.advisory.unreachable-waiver); no positive evidence defaults to potentially_reachable.

reachabilityBinding.$comment: The assumptions the classification is parasitic on; drift in any of them invalidates dependent waivers early (release.waiver.invalidation).

evidenceRefs.$comment: Call-graph output, SBOM entry, analysis artifacts — the positive evidence behind an unreachable classification.

sbomRef.$comment: The SBOM digest the component_absent check was made against (release.advisory.component-absent); required for that classification.

allOf.$comment: An unreachable classification is only as good as its bindings and its positive evidence (release.advisory.reachability-binding); a schema-valid unreachable with none of them is the laundering the rules prohibit.
component_absent is self-verifying only against a named SBOM of the final artifact (release.advisory.component-absent).
